AMENDMENT NO. 1 dated as of April 1, 2026 to the Credit Agreement dated as of January 15, 2026, among Cedar Valley Robotics, Inc., as Borrower, the Lenders party hereto and Pioneer Mutual Bank, as Administrative Agent.

SECTION 1. Amendments . The definition of "Consolidated EBITDA" in Section 1.01 of the Credit Agreement is hereby amended and restated in its entirety to read as follows: "Consolidated EBITDA" means, for any period, Consolidated Net Income for such period plus, without duplication, Interest Expense and depreciation and amortization expense for such period.

SECTION 2. Effectiveness . This Amendment shall become effective on April 1, 2026.
